description.value: The study examined the relation between uncinate fasciculus structural connectivity and amygdala habituation in adolescents using DTI and an fMRI emotional face processing task, including moderation by pubertal status.
A population-based adolescent neuroimaging study using simultaneous structural and functional imaging data.

definition.value: higher FA values were associated with more amygdala habituation to fearful faces

spans.text: Multiple regression analyses in SPM8 examining the relation between left UF FA and left amygdala habituation revealed a positive relation, such that higher FA values were associated with more amygdala habituation to fearful faces, t (96) = 3.76, p = .003, XYZ = −26, −2, −18; see Table 4 and Figure 1 .

value: Multiple regression analyses revealed a positive relation, such that higher left UF FA values were associated with more left amygdala habituation to fearful faces.
The positive relation between UF FA and amygdala habituation suggested that increased structural connectivity of the UF facilitates prefrontal cortical regulation of the amygdala in adolescence.

spans.text: We assessed age, pubertal status, and gender as potential moderators of any significant relations between amygdala habituation and UF FA.
